source: 本地策展（公开流传名言）

quotes.text: 千里之行，始于足下。
quotes.author: 老子

quotes.text: 天行健，君子以自强不息。
quotes.author: 《周易》

quotes.text: 路漫漫其修远兮，吾将上下而求索。
quotes.author: 屈原

quotes.text: 不积跬步，无以至千里；不积小流，无以成江海。
quotes.author: 荀子

quotes.text: 业精于勤，荒于嬉；行成于思，毁于随。
quotes.author: 韩愈

quotes.text: 山重水复疑无路，柳暗花明又一村。
quotes.author: 陆游

quotes.text: 人生自古谁无死，留取丹心照汗青。
quotes.author: 文天祥

quotes.text: 海纳百川，有容乃大；壁立千仞，无欲则刚。
quotes.author: 林则徐

quotes.text: 横眉冷对千夫指，俯首甘为孺子牛。
quotes.author: 鲁迅

quotes.text: 希望是本无所谓有，无所谓无的。这正如地上的路；其实地上本没有路，走的人多了，也便成了路。
quotes.author: 鲁迅

quotes.text: 生活的理想，就是为了理想的生活。
quotes.author: 张闻天

quotes.text: 人最宝贵的是生命，生命对每个人只有一次。
quotes.author: 奥斯特洛夫斯基

quotes.text: 幸福的家庭都是相似的，不幸的家庭各有各的不幸。
quotes.author: 列夫·托尔斯泰

quotes.text: 世界上最宽阔的是海洋，比海洋更宽阔的是天空，比天空更宽阔的是人的胸怀。
quotes.author: 雨果

quotes.text: 人不是为失败而生的，一个人可以被毁灭，但不能被打败。
quotes.author: 海明威

quotes.text: 如果你不出去走走，你会以为这就是世界。
quotes.author: 佚名

quotes.text: 知之者不如好之者，好之者不如乐之者。
quotes.author: 孔子

quotes.text: 三人行，必有我师焉。择其善者而从之，其不善者而改之。
quotes.author: 孔子

quotes.text: 学而不思则罔，思而不学则殆。
quotes.author: 孔子

quotes.text: 富贵不能淫，贫贱不能移，威武不能屈，此之谓大丈夫。
quotes.author: 孟子

quotes.text: 纸上得来终觉浅，绝知此事要躬行。
quotes.author: 陆游

quotes.text: 读万卷书，行万里路。
quotes.author: 刘彝

quotes.text: 宝剑锋从磨砺出，梅花香自苦寒来。
quotes.author: 佚名

quotes.text: 长风破浪会有时，直挂云帆济沧海。
quotes.author: 李白

quotes.text: 会当凌绝顶，一览众山小。
quotes.author: 杜甫

quotes.text: 莫愁前路无知己，天下谁人不识君。
quotes.author: 高适

quotes.text: 落红不是无情物，化作春泥更护花。
quotes.author: 龚自珍

quotes.text: 采菊东篱下，悠然见南山。
quotes.author: 陶渊明

quotes.text: 先天下之忧而忧，后天下之乐而乐。
quotes.author: 范仲淹

quotes.text: 不以物喜，不以己悲。
quotes.author: 范仲淹

quotes.text: Stay hungry, stay foolish.
quotes.author: Steve Jobs

quotes.text: The only way to do great work is to love what you do.
quotes.author: Steve Jobs

quotes.text: Innovation distinguishes between a leader and a follower.
quotes.author: Steve Jobs

quotes.text: The future belongs to those who believe in the beauty of their dreams.
quotes.author: Eleanor Roosevelt

quotes.text: Be the change that you wish to see in the world.
quotes.author: Mahatma Gandhi

quotes.text: It does not matter how slowly you go as long as you do not stop.
quotes.author: Confucius

quotes.text: Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts.
quotes.author: Winston Churchill

quotes.text: In the middle of every difficulty lies opportunity.
quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.text: Imagination is more important than knowledge.
quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.text: Life is what happens when you're busy making other plans.
quotes.author: John Lennon

quotes.text: The only impossible journey is the one you never begin.
quotes.author: Tony Robbins

quotes.text: Whether you think you can, or you think you can't, you're right.
quotes.author: Henry Ford

quotes.text: The best way to predict the future is to create it.
quotes.author: Peter Drucker

quotes.text: Do what you can, with what you have, where you are.
quotes.author: Theodore Roosevelt

quotes.text: What we think, we become.
quotes.author: Buddha

quotes.text: The mind is everything. What you think you become.
quotes.author: Buddha

quotes.text: Strive not to be a success, but rather to be of value.
quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.text: Two roads diverged in a wood, and I took the one less traveled by.
quotes.author: Robert Frost

quotes.text: To be, or not to be, that is the question.
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.text: All the world's a stage, and all the men and women merely players.
quotes.author: William Shakespeare

quotes.text: It always seems impossible until it's done.
quotes.author: Nelson Mandela

quotes.text: The journey of a thousand miles begins with one step.
quotes.author: Lao Tzu

quotes.text: Knowing yourself is the beginning of all wisdom.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.text: Happiness is not something ready made. It comes from your own actions.
quotes.author: Dalai Lama

quotes.text: What you get by achieving your goals is not as important as what you become by achieving your goals.
quotes.author: Zig Ziglar

quotes.text: Your time is limited, so don't waste it living someone else's life.
quotes.author: Steve Jobs

quotes.text: The only person you are destined to become is the person you decide to be.
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.text: We may encounter many defeats but we must not be defeated.
quotes.author: Maya Angelou

quotes.text: Everything you've ever wanted is on the other side of fear.
quotes.author: George Addair

quotes.text: Hardships often prepare ordinary people for an extraordinary destiny.
quotes.author: C.S. Lewis
